address: Daleside Nurseries, Ripon Road, Killinghall, Harrogate, HG3 2AY, United Kingdom
bio: A smart, spacious café behind a garden centre; if it’s sunny, grab a seat on the terrace overlooking the lake. They’re open for breakfast, brunch and lunch, and the frequently changing menu offers seasonal dishes which are fresh, unfussy and full of flavour. Book the chef’s table to watch the kitchen at work....
